app.title: Show HN: SubSmith – Turn your own videos into language-learning material
app.author: IbrahimF96
app.description: A web application that lets users upload videos and auto‑generate subtitles, flashcards, and quizzes for language learning.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run docker compose up -d
Verify the web UI loads on http://localhost:3000
Upload a sample video and confirm subtitles are generated
Check the API endpoint /api/flashcards returns JSON
Measure average processing time for a 1‑minute video
